_status: DRAFT. Every value must be clinician-verified against the cited source before entering a build. Fields marked _verify:true are not yet confirmed.

prototype.label: PROTOTYPE ONLY - unverified clinical guideline pack may execute only in explicitly labelled prototype builds.

source: WHO/UNICEF 2012 pneumonia/diarrhoea materials; WHO/UNICEF 2004 acute-diarrhoea statement; WHO 2019 sick-young-infant chart booklet and participant manual; WHO IMCI fever module; Bangladesh EPI (DGHS).

ari._note: IMCI fast-breathing thresholds drive the Respiration Timer's rate check.

zinc._source: WHO/UNICEF joint statement 2004; reaffirmed UNICEF 2012 report

dangerSigns: sunken eyes / signs of severe dehydration

antibiotics._note: The 'no antibiotics' voucher renders ONLY when there is no blood in stool AND no danger sign.

voucher.en: MOH guidance: my child needs ORS and zinc. No antibiotics needed.

immunization._note: Bangladesh EPI schedule. Populate + verify against DGHS/EPI Bangladesh and WHO-UNICEF coverage estimates.

malaria.note: Country/localizer policy controls whether malaria testing is relevant. Test validity is deliberately unresolved until the national protocol is approved.
malaria._source: WHO IMCI fever pathway; national malaria protocol required

fever._source: WHO IMCI fever module; persistent-no-improvement timing is prototype product policy pending review
fever._provenance: Axillary site only; no offset is inferred for oral, rectal, ear, or forehead readings

young_infant._source: WHO 2019 sick young infant chart booklet and participant manual
young_infant._provenance: Clinical young-infant band is 0-59 completed days; this does not redefine the app newborn persona
